title: Interview with Gita
summary: Lena interviewed Gita, a biologist, in a podcast conversation.

qa_highlights.question: What would you tell someone just starting out?
qa_highlights.answer: Write down what you tried even when it fails

qa_highlights.question: Tell me about a project that failed.
qa_highlights.answer: A mobile version nobody asked for cost six months and taught them to ask first

qa_highlights.question: How did people react when it came out?
qa_highlights.answer: Mostly curiosity, and some critics said the method was too slow

qa_highlights.question: How do you keep a balance?
qa_highlights.answer: Protects Sundays with no messages or screens and a long walk

quotes.speaker: Gita
quotes.text: Failed experiments teach you the most.

quotes.speaker: Gita
quotes.text: It cost us six months and taught us to ask first.

quotes.speaker: Gita
quotes.text: No messages, no screens, just a long walk.
